subject.title: feat(onboard): guided onboarding becomes the custodian flow

question: Should plain local `openclaw onboard` permanently change from conversational setup handoff to automatic setup application and direct agent hatch, with `wizard.accessMode` as persisted discovery policy?
rationale: This changes a documented CLI setup contract, introduces persistent configuration, and intentionally removes a conversational confirmation boundary; tests can verify mechanics but cannot authorize that product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve after boundary fixes
options.body: Adopt the custodian flow for plain local onboarding after fixing the setup caller and guarded configured-install regressions and proving rerun safety.

options.title: Keep chat as the default
options.body: Preserve conversational handoff as the shared default and require an explicit onboarding-only mode before local apply and hatch can run.

options.title: Land discovery changes only
options.body: Keep consent and quieter route selection but defer automatic apply and hatch until the remaining redesign phases are ready.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary fixes
recommendation.body: Adopt the custodian flow for plain local onboarding after fixing the setup caller and guarded configured-install regressions and proving rerun safety.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed living design document identifies this as a coordinated multi-phase onboarding direction, and this person owns the proposal plus related current-main onboarding surfaces.
